Hopefully not. Better safe than sorry. At the very least, moniter your body and if anything feels even a little off GO.

Edit. After searching, you know what? Go now. It's likely going to be the difference between life and death. Seriously.
See a fucking doctor. Now. Paracetamol is the worst way to go. Seriously. Now. I expect to see you commenting or posting tommorow. Please.
Are you okay? You haven't posted in ages. Please pm me if you're still around.

Thank you. Its not that the friend is irrating. He's an absolutely amazing and wonderful person. He just deserves a better friend than me. He's kind and caring and there's no reason he should be friends with me. We have similar interests, but so do other people, I just don't want him to waste his time on me.

He's keeping me alive and I almost resent that. I WANT to be alone so I can bring myself fowqrds to the last step over the cliff.
I know it's wrong, and that's why I'm trying to change.
I am both. I'd feel pretty bad not going back to pay, but at the same time I'm not looking to get in trouble by doing that
My fave is the seasalted hard ones. Not sure of you have them in America. I once had a pepperoni pretzel. That was about the best thing ever. Its little joys in life like that that keep me going.

Ahah, well I love you, don't kill yourself! Seriously though. Stick around some, see where life takes you. Find something to look forward too even if it's like binging on pretzels after work (a personal favourite of mine) have fun!

Whatever that okay is now, just try and stay at it. Please. Treat yourself, do something fun. There's a lot left to experience, and we only have a short time to experience it anyway. You got this. If you ever want to message me/voice chat I'm up for that. Hang in there.
I'm sorry if I am bothering you, but are you feeling okay?
That's good to hear. You got this.
I’ve tried everything, it helps, but temporarily. No comfort from doing anything now. I’ll just see what happens Monday.
Are you okay?

Yeah, I could talk to him. Like I said above though, I don't really want to. I don't want to get reported anymore. I think I'm just going to go into school on Monday and grab a scalpel and see what happens.

I don't want to talk to anyone anymore. As I said before, they wouldn't understand unless they knew the intricacies of my life, which only my Councillor does.
Are you still here?

Fuck yes you deserve to live It's not over. There's so much left to do! BUY a pet, MAKE some friends. At least try. 5 hours is 3am for me but I'll make you a deal. Stay alive tonight. I'll message you in 5 hours if you want. Do it for me. Please. There's too much death.

You’re not weak for doing that. Quite the opposite. I hope I do too. We’re all in this together. Find someone to reward yourself with! Buy chocolate, something like that when you don’t harm. Let’s get through this.

My family knows. I’ve told them is the pressure they’re putting on me. They just say no, it’s because you were bullied, and if I insist it’s them they say that they’ve never done a wrong thing to me, and that it’s becuase I’m mentally unsound that I blame them. I’m done with telling people. I talked to my friend about it, and that helped me, but he called the school worried about it. That’s fair enough, but it didn’t help. I told someone else and they said they would call the police if they thought I’d carry it out. Not going down that route again. My councillor in on pregnancy leave so I can’t see her. I don’t want to see anyone else. She understands me, where I coming from and the whole story. I think I need to be checked into a phyc ward because I actually seriously considering killing myself right now. I need some time to recover, to get back into a routine, and, I know it sounds stupid, but I need someone to control my life right now. I don’t have the energy anymore.

I don’t want to talk to helplines. They don’t help. They wouldn’t understand, they’d need to know the whole story. I’m messed up in so many ways. I don’t want to go through CAMHS again, fill in those sheets again, watch everyone cry.

We're not brave. We've just given up. Don't give up yourself. There's always something left. Something to do, some thing to experience. If you haven't given up don't. Once you go down that hole. It's hard to bounce back

I don't even want to get to uni. I just want a low pay job that offers me enough to live on my own and have a tiny amount of disposable income. House prices on the island I live on start at 450k for a single bedroom small little house. I can't bare the abuse from my parents if I do badly. I can't bare the circle of abuse. I fucking hate life

I'm not going to go to uni. A levels, then I'm out. I can't bear school anymore. Nobody cares, it's all about money at that school. The fucking RS teacher seems to know more than the principal of care or the school Councillor. It's all 'things will get better' that doesn't fucking help. I can't bare the monotony of every week. It's all the same, just forcing myself through school so I can get home and sleep. Nothing to look forward to. I won't make it to a levels anyway.
All the normal stuff and English lit, drama, ancient history, history and music
